newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN says unlikely to repeat 1995/6 record.
newsitem.headline: EVN says unlikely to repeat 1995/6 record.

text.p: Lower Austrian regional utility Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich AG (EVN) said on Tuesday record earnings in 1995/6 were partly due to an unusually severe winter and were unlikely to be repeated.

"The temperature development in 1995/6 was a one-off. Despite economic growth in Lower Austria above the national average and expansion in gas and district heating, such a result is not repeatable given normal weather conditions," chief executive Rudolf Gruber said in a statement.
